title: tier-2: the same AnimTimeWrap oracle, candidate is the rust_probe implementation
notes: Same oracle as fn/AnimTimeWrap; the candidate is rust_probe.rs via the subprocess protocol.
Proves the tier-2 loader runs the full five-stage ladder, not just the selftest's differential slice.
Mutants are line-edits of rust_probe.rs; a mutant that fails rustc is counted killed.
